## Every region gained at least 14 years

Asia rose from 45.6 years in 1950 to 74.9 in 2019, the largest gain at 29.3 years. Europe rose from 64.6 to 78.8 years, the smallest gain at 14.2 years. In 2019, Europe led at 78.8 years, followed by the Americas at 77.5, Asia at 74.9 and Africa at 65.2. Asia's estimate dipped to 40.7 years in 1960; Africa's series was comparatively flat in the 1990s.
